result.topic_en: A draft announcement of Riemann's summer semester 1858 lectures (mathematical theory of gravitation, electricity and magnetism; exercises on physical problems), dated Göttingen April 1858, together with scattered algebraic calculations involving square-root sums, quadratic expressions in α, β, γ, δ and x, y, and small 0/1 tables.
result.transcription:
Sommersemester [-1857-] 1858
Grade [?] Vorlesungen [?]:
1. Mathematische Theorie der Gravitation [?] und der Electricität [?] und des Magnetismus [?]. Montags, Dienstags, Mittwochs, Donnerstags und Freitags [?] von 9-10 Uhr [?].
2. Übungen [?]: Ausgewählte [?] physikalische Probleme [?] Mittwochs [?] 9-10 Uhr [?]
Ich werde anfangen, sobald sich eine hinreichende Anzahl [?] gemeldet haben.

Göttingen, den 17 April [?] 1858

$2\beta'\gamma' + \alpha\delta' + \ldots - \alpha^2 - \delta^2$ [?]
$= \beta^2 + 2\alpha\gamma + \gamma^2 + 2\beta\delta - 2\alpha\beta' - 2\gamma\delta'$ [?]
$(\beta+\delta)^2 + (\alpha+\gamma)^2 = 2(\alpha+\gamma)(\beta'+\delta')$ [?]
$(\beta'+\delta')^2 + (\alpha'+\gamma')^2 = 2(\alpha+\gamma)(\beta+\delta)$ [?]
$\beta\delta + \alpha\gamma = \beta'\delta' + \alpha'\gamma'$ [?]
$2(\beta\delta) = (1+i)(\beta'+\delta') + (1-i)(\alpha'+\gamma')$ [?]
$2(\alpha+\gamma) = (1-i)(\beta'+\delta') + (1+i)(\alpha'+\gamma')$ [?]

$\sqrt{x(\beta+\gamma+z)} - \sqrt{y(\alpha+\gamma+z)} - \sqrt{z(\beta+\gamma+z)} = 0$ [?]
$\sqrt{y(\alpha+y+z)} - \sqrt{z(x+y+z)} + \sqrt{x(\beta+y+z)} = 0$ [?]
$\sqrt{xy}\;\sqrt{x(\beta+y+z)} + \sqrt{y(\alpha+z+x)} + \sqrt{z(\alpha+y+z)} = 0$ [?]
$\sqrt{z_1 z_2} + \sqrt{z_3 z_4} + \sqrt{z_5 z_6} + \sqrt{z_7 z_8}$
$\sqrt{z_1 z_4} + \sqrt{z_2 z_3} + \sqrt{z_5 z_8}$ [?]
$-2x^2 y (\alpha\beta + \gamma\delta + \alpha\delta + \beta\gamma)$ [?]

$a_{22}$ $a_{42}$ $\alpha\beta' - \alpha'$ [?]
$a_{21}$ $a_{41}$ $\gamma\delta' - b$ [?]
$\gamma\delta' + b$ $\gamma\delta + b$ $\delta^2$ [?]
$\beta^2 + 2\gamma\delta' - \alpha\beta - \gamma\delta + a - b$ [?]
$= \beta^2 + 2\alpha\gamma' - \alpha\beta - \gamma\delta - a + b$ [?]
$= \beta^2 + 2\alpha\gamma - \alpha\beta' - \gamma\delta' - a' + b'$ [?]
$= \gamma^2 + 2\beta\delta - \alpha\beta' - \gamma\delta' + a' - b'$ [?]

$x(\alpha x^2 - \ldots) + (\ldots) = xy(x-y)(xy-1)$ [?]
$x(\alpha+y)^2 + xy(\alpha y + \ldots)^2$ [?]
$(1+xy)(x-y)(\alpha\beta'\alpha - \gamma\delta' y) + x(\alpha x + \gamma)^2 + y(\beta x + \delta)^2 + (x-y)(xy-1)(\alpha xy + \ldots)$ [?]
$(x+y)(xy-1)(\alpha\beta' xy - \gamma\delta') + xy(\alpha xy + \gamma)^2 + (\beta xy + \delta)^2$ [?]
$- (x+y)(\alpha xy + \gamma)(\beta xy + \delta)$ [?]
$\alpha x^3 + \ldots + \alpha^2 y(\beta^2 + 2\alpha\beta') - \ldots + (\gamma^2 + 2\beta\delta)xy^2 + (\gamma^2 + \ldots)\beta\delta + \delta^2\ldots$ [?]
$(\alpha x y^2 + \beta xy + \gamma x + \delta)(\alpha x^2 y + \beta xy + \gamma y + \delta) - (x+y)xy(\alpha xy + \gamma)(\beta xy + \delta)$ [?]
$xy(\alpha xy + \gamma)^2 + (\beta xy + \delta)^2$
$\alpha xy(\alpha x y^2 + \beta(x+y)(yx-1) + 2\gamma xy)$ [?]
